problem.problem_class: Proceeds with the HTTPS connection despite SSL errors
problem.description: Permitting connections with SSL-related errors could allow eavesdroppers to intercept data sent by your app, which impacts the privacy of your users. Consider canceling the connections by invoking SslErrorHandler#cancel().
